title: On the Interplay between Human Label Variation and Model Fairness
reasoning: The paper focuses on model fairness and social bias, specifically investigating how human label variation (HLV) affects fairness metrics. While it evaluates offensiveness (Social Bias Inference Corpus) and cites Rawls' theory of justice, it does not explicitly benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical systems beyond technical algorithmic fairness.
